summary: First-party English and Hindi discovery identified Rajasthan Revenue/Settlement Department services, NIC BhuNaksha, Apna Khata, and Rajdharaa Urban GIS. The current Urban GIS configuration was inspected, but bounded anonymous parcel metadata/query requests timed out; no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries and URLs, direct page requests, current JavaScript/configuration inspection, response outcomes, and schema/CRS availability are recorded in city-8106-banswara.json. BhuNaksha pages and the configured GIS host timed out; Rajdharaa Urban GIS itself returned HTTP 200. No login, credential, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or unsafe field request was used.
